name: Starry Heavenly Armiger
name_jp: 極星ファントムソード天
effects:
Grants [Master Mode], [Instant ATB 1], [Diffusion Barrier 1] to user
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 2, Hero Boost +25%, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast 1
Interval Chase: 10 single-target Lightning/NE physical attacks, Hero Boost +30/35/40/45/50% & Cap Break Level 3/4/5/6/7 to user after 1/2/3/4/5 chases (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Lightning/NE physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1; Cap Break Level 9, Instant Cast, & Hero Boost +50% for 1 turn to user; [Instant ATB 1] to user if Prompto is in party; removes Master Mode
